description:
In every relationship, a deep tension exists between two contrasting needs: the desire for complete togetherness and the vital necessity of separatedness. We want to merge, yet we also need our own space to think, work, and stay intact. 
Start your free Membership trial – 2,000+ articles, 1,000+ videos, 50+ courses, free for a week: https://www.theschooloflife.com/membership

When couples run into trouble, it is often because these dual forces—like a car's accelerator and brake—are out of sync, leading to panic, distance, or acting out. In this film, we explore how to master the art of moving between closeness and autonomy without derailing the car of love.

"In the life of every couple, and individual, lies a tension between two central and contrasting needs: the need for ‘togetherness’ on the one hand, for ‘separatedness’ on the other.
